# Cassio Matoso

> Full Stack Web Developer specialized in legacy systems modernization, based in Santo Antônio das Missões, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.

Cassio Matoso is a Full Stack Web Developer from Brazil with 8+ years of experience in web development, software maintenance, and architecture modernization. He specializes in PHP and JavaScript/TypeScript legacy systems, including critical bug fixing, performance optimization, and migration to modern architectures. Currently employed at Sistema Gerencial Txai | Grupo Txai and open to evaluating new proposals aligned with full stack, legacy modernization, and cloud/serverless challenges.

Core expertise: PHP, Laravel, CodeIgniter, Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js, ViNext (Cloudflare), TypeScript, AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Platform, Vercel, REST APIs, Git, GitLab.
